articles.title: Russian strike kills 8 in Ukraine's Odesa as Kremlin envoy heads to U.S. for truce talks
articles.summary: A Russian missile strike hit port infrastructure in Odesa, southern Ukraine, killing eight and wounding 27 people, Ukraine's emergency service reported. This incident highlights the relentless targeting of critical infrastructure and the severe human cost of the ongoing conflict, occurring despite reports of a Kremlin envoy's travel for potential diplomatic engagements.
